metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.5 · 1999 · Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
metas.description: Two Jedi escape a hostile blockade to find allies and come across a young boy who may bring balance to the Force, but the long-dormant Sith resurface to claim their former glory.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.6 · 2002 · Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
metas.description: Ten years after initially meeting, Anakin Skywalker shares a forbidden romance with Padmé Amidala, while Obi-Wan Kenobi discovers a secret clone army crafted for the Jedi.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.0 · 2008 · Star Wars: The Clone Wars
metas.description: As the Clone Wars sweep the galaxy, Anakin Skywalker and his new Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, embark on a mission to rescue the kidnapped son of Jabba the Hutt. However, the renegade Count Dooku is determined to ensure that they fail.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.7 · 2005 · Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
metas.description: As the Clone Wars nears its end, Obi-Wan Kenobi pursues a new threat, while Anakin Skywalker is lured by Chancellor Palpatine into a sinister plot for galactic domination.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.9 · 2018 · Solo: A Star Wars Story
metas.description: During an adventure in the criminal underworld, Han Solo meets his future co-pilot Chewbacca and Lando Calrissian years before joining the Rebel Alliance.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 7.8 · 2016 · Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
metas.description: In a time of conflict, a group of unlikely heroes band together on a mission to steal the plans to the Death Star, the Empire's ultimate weapon of destruction.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 8.6 · 1977 · Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
metas.description: Luke Skywalker joins forces with a Jedi Knight, a cocky pilot, a Wookiee and two droids to save the galaxy from the Empire's world-destroying battle station, while also attempting to rescue Princess Leia from the mysterious Darth ...

metas.name: 8 · ★ 8.7 · 1980 · Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back
metas.description: After the Empire overpowers the Rebel Alliance, Luke Skywalker begins training with Jedi Master Yoda, while Darth Vader and bounty hunter Boba Fett pursue his friends across the galaxy.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 8.3 · 1983 · Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
metas.description: After rescuing Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt, the Rebel Alliance attempts to destroy the second Death Star while Luke struggles to help Darth Vader back from the dark side.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 7.7 · 2015 · Star Wars: Episode VII - The Force Awakens
metas.description: As a new threat to the galaxy rises, Rey, a desert scavenger, and Finn, an ex-stormtrooper, must join Han Solo and Chewbacca to search for the one hope of restoring peace.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 6.8 · 2017 · Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi
metas.description: Rey develops her abilities with the help of Luke Skywalker as the Resistance prepares for battle against the First Order.

metas.name: 12 · ★ 6.3 · 2019 · Star Wars: Episode IX - The Rise of Skywalker
metas.description: The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again.
